name: io.github.mac146/issuewatcher
description: Ranks new GitHub issues for your AI assistant: what to pick up, what may break your projects.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A GitHub personal access token with read-only access. Create one at https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new

environmentVariables.name: SCORING_MODE
environmentVariables.description: contributor (issues you could pick up), consumer (issues that may break your projects) or both.
